coverage_limits: Only highlighted course families were searched in detail. The 145-row ledger is complete as an inventory, but unhighlighted rows are marked not_individually_searched.
Exact current-code mapping is unresolved for official experimental pages with historical or combined course titles.
GitHub search is incomplete; one query returned a 429 rate limit and was not retried.
Official binary PDF/PPT files were not downloaded or read; page titles, visible file names, domain/footer, and syllabus metadata were inspected.
No license granting redistribution was confirmed. Links are retained to source pages; materials were not re-hosted.
One FDU-Sharing filename for 普化A下期末 is listed within the 普化A上 page. It is retained as a separate lower-course candidate, not proof of a dedicated lower-course page.
One historical Fudan Physical Chemistry A II handout index is visible but requires UIS login; it is recorded as access-controlled and excluded from public material counts.

Historical course codes in the Chemistry strong-foundation plan and the double-degree recommendation are recorded as historical references only; they are not treated as direct mappings to newer current-scope codes.

The Xueyin Organic Chemistry A page exposes course description/metadata but no public downloadable files in the inspected rendering. The Chaoxing course item redirects to a course portal that the web reader could not retrieve; no login or credentials were used.
The legacy analytical-chemistry experiment index repeats the same 18 PPT titles as the inorganic/chemical-analysis experiment page and is treated as a duplicate path, not an extra resource set.
The physical-chemistry lab PPT index does not allocate experiments to upper/lower courses; its association to CHEM30032 remains candidate-only.

The ordinary-chemistry-C and organic-chemistry-C official JWC PDFs were identified through indexed extracted text; direct open attempts failed (large-file limit or timeout). Their metadata is context only and is not counted as courseware.

The Fudan Xianghui course-resources index points to the Chaoxing portal but does not expose study files. The listed Fudan Organic Chemistry AI portal item redirects to a course page the web reader cannot retrieve; no login was attempted.

Public GitHub tree checks found no chemistry materials in the checked Fudan course-wiki and computer-major repositories. This is a repository-path check, not an exhaustive search of every public GitHub repository.
CHEM40004 综合化学实验I has an official course-index candidate, but the public page contains no visible course materials; it is recorded as a checked empty index and not as a resource page.
CHEM20016 分析化学实验 is only a title-family candidate from the legacy 分析化学实验课件 index; its 18 PPT names duplicate CR-002 and are counted once.
CHEM10006 有机化学实验I is a historical-outline candidate only; CHEM120011 is a historical code and no crosswalk to current CHEM10006 was found.

A five-course high-enrollment exact-title search batch found no new verifiable study-material links. Rows are marked searched_no_verified_resource; this is bounded search coverage and does not prove that no material exists.

The third-party Xuehai.net 有机化学笔记 page is a weak lead without author/term/current-course provenance and is excluded. A detailed Chaoxing organic chemistry page explicitly identifies 忻州师范学院 and is excluded as another-school content.
rights_summary: Public access does not grant redistribution rights. FDU-Sharing has no LICENSE file found and README reserves original authors rights. Official Fudan material pages carry a copyright notice; no open license found. Xueyin pages show no downloadable materials or open license.
